description: Approve an owned grant that was created with requires_approval. Opens stay blocked until this succeeds. Requires your API key.

api_key.description: Secret API key from signup. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass this only when you cannot set headers. Do not write it into a file you share.

grant_id.description: grant_id returned when the share was created.

name: approve_share
title: Approve a share
